output.summary: An annual herb that may persist as a biennial or perennial in favourable conditions, dwarf mallow is native to most of the Old World except sub-Saharan Africa. It grows low to the ground, with downy, kidney-shaped or shallowly lobed leaves and small flower clusters partly hidden by the leaves.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves and seeds are eaten raw or cooked; stalks are also edible, and seeds were formerly ground into flour in times of need.
